Claim Petition For Compensation.

This Appeal Coming On For Admission This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
The learned counsel for the appellant prays for time.
On perusal of records, it is evident that the appeal against respondent No.1-Owner was dismissed on 06.08.2021 itself.
However, inspite of lapse of two years, no steps were taken for recalling the said order.
When the appeal against respondent No.1 itself is dismissed, who is the owner, the question of fastening the liability of Insurance Company-respondent No.2 does not arise at all.
Hence, the question of admitting the appeal does not arise at all.
As such, the appeal stands dismissed.
